timezone_decision.decision: strip suffix; interpret stored values as Australia/Melbourne local wall clock; convert to UTC
timezone_decision.rules_2014: AEDT UTC+11 until 2014-04-06 03:00 local; AEST UTC+10 until 2014-10-05 02:00; AEDT UTC+11 after; DST hours handled hour-wise on the two transition days
timezone_decision.evidence: diurnal arrival histogram peaks 07:00-18:00 local and troughs 01:00-05:00, consistent with published meter restriction hours 07:30-19:30; if values were true UTC the peak would sit at local 18:00-05:00, inconsistent with paid CBD parking; see data/qa/QA_REPORT.md
timezone_decision.unresolved: phrase labels cannot be independently confirmed from a second source; archived sensor data has no separate UTC column

austin_parking_transactions.limitation: paid duration not measured dwell; no capacity column

seattle_2019_paid_parking_occupancy.limitation: aggregated blockface snapshots; has parkingspacecount capacity

acn_data.license: UNVERIFIED (no LICENSE in mirror; official access requires registration)
acn_data.limitation: charging sessions only; cannot produce non-charging EV parking denominator

st_evcdp.scope: 1,706 stations (stations.csv rows), 8,640 five-minute steps (2022-06-19..2022-07-18), aggregated occupancy; no session-level arrival/departure

probe_artifacts: data/raw/_probe/ (catalog JSON, samples, API responses; not part of the primary raw data)
limitations: Melbourne 2014 event counts/site counts must be read from lead's data/qa/source_stats.json; this file intentionally does not duplicate them
raw timestamp offset label +0000 is not trustworthy; UTC conversion depends on the local-wall-clock assumption documented above
site_capacity is derived (distinct BayID per StreetId x SideCode); no single canonical site definition in source
one row per occupancy event (arrival+departure); missing departure = right-censored
no EV attribute and no kWh in the primary dataset

contract.scenario_layer: is_ev/needs_charge/energy_kwh/hardware are scenario fields; arrival/dwell/site are observed
